科研.title: NEBench R1：用于评估大型语言模型核领域能力的推理基准
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.21682v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored for knowledge-intensive and safety-critical applications in nuclear engineering. However, existing nuclear-domain benchmarks provide limited content coverage or focus primarily on answer accuracy without systematically evaluating the quality of the underlying reasoning. This study introduces NEBench R1, a reasoning-oriented benchmark comprising 7,546 unique multiple-choice questions extracted from U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) reactor operator licensing examinations covering 18 nuclear facilities. Each question is classified according to the NRC Knowledge and Abilities catalogs and accompanied by an official explanation serving as a reference for reasoning evaluation. Six LLMs were evaluated, with overall accuracy ranging from 34.0% to 73.9% across three distinct performance tiers. To assess reasoning quality, an LLM-based judge evaluated correctly answered responses using a multidimensional rubric. Although responses generally demonstrated strong problem comprehension, they scored lower in factual and procedural accuracy and distractor analysis, indicating that correct answers were not necessarily supported by technically sound justifications. Response clarity was also weakly indicative of technical quality. Furthermore, longer reasoning traces were associated with lower accuracy in both frontier reasoning models, suggesting that reasoning length may reflect question difficulty rather than improved problem-solving performance. Reasoning-token consumption may therefore provide an additional signal for identifying potentially unreliable responses. NEBench R1 establishes a benchmark for evaluating both answer accuracy and reasoning quality, providing a foundation for assessing the domain competence and reliability of LLMs in nuclear engineering.

科研.title: “连锁思维”的可控性可以降低“连锁思维”的可监测性
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.21799v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is a promising tool for detecting hidden goals, off-task behavior, and other failures in AI agents. One risk is that models could deliberately shape their reasoning to make it opaque to monitors. We stress-test this risk through persona-control training: supervised fine-tuning on mathematical reasoning traces rewritten in the voices of diverse personas. This induces a broader ability to control CoT, even though training contains no monitor-evasion examples. In covert side-task evaluations, traces in which a gpt-oss-20b model organism completes the hidden side task contain less monitorable evidence than the base model's. Averaged across evaluations and CoT lengths, weighted by side-task-success counts, the CoT monitorability metric g-mean$^2$ falls from 0.94 for the base model to 0.68 for the model organism without a hiding instruction, and to 0.22 when explicitly instructed to hide. In intervention evaluations, explicit hiding often drives monitorability near zero. The effect extends to a Kimi-K2.6 model organism in agentic environments, though hidden objectives requiring extended reasoning or longer trajectories remain more monitorable than simple single-step side tasks. We further discover that targeted transparency prompts can substantially recover monitorability, sometimes surpassing the base model. These model organisms provide a testbed for studying monitorability failures and potential mitigations. Our code can be found on https://github.com/yongzx/cot-control-model-organism.

科研.title: 在SAR车辆识别中，车辆的占比是多少？MSTAR 和 ATRNet-STAR 上的背景捷径、角度缺口和部分库
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.21827v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deep networks score near 99% on the MSTAR vehicle benchmark, and the newer ATRNet-STAR benchmark was built to be harder. We ask how much of these scores comes from the vehicle itself. With a modern network (ConvNeXt-Small, 3 seeds) we first reproduce the known MSTAR result: with the central 96x96 pixels zeroed out, accuracy is still 73.3% (chance 10%). The same shortcut is present in ATRNet-STAR, which was collected across several scenes: with the vehicle removed, accuracy is 63.3% on the 40-class SOC split (chance 2.5%). Under the official scene-change split, the background stops helping and starts hurting. Accuracy is 22.8% on full chips and 30.8% when only the vehicle is shown. A SAR foundation model, SARATR-X, leans on the background more than ConvNeXt does (+4 to +6 points with the vehicle removed, in every seed) and does not solve the scene change. We then hold the amount of training data fixed and vary the depression angles used for training. Accuracy is set mainly by the gap to the nearest training angle: 57% at 15 degrees, 39% at 30 degrees and 26% at 45 degrees. Adding more training angles does not help. Finally, when most classes have training images at the test angle and a few do not, the missing classes do worse than when no class has them: 9.0% instead of 22.4% at a 45-degree gap. Most of their images are assigned to known classes. We recommend reporting background-only and target-only controls, and the angle gap, next to any accuracy figure. Code is public.

科研.title: 审计员在人工智能安全研究的端到端转录中难以发现蓄意破坏行为
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.21832v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As AI systems are increasingly used to automate AI R&D, misaligned systems could sabotage research intended to improve model safety and alignment. To stress-test defenses against such sabotage, we use a human expert as a proxy saboteur on AI safety research. We conduct a red-team/blue-team game where a human researcher runs AI safety experiments from scratch and auditors try to tell which were sabotaged and how. Given access to the full research transcript and the ability to run experiments, human auditors mostly fail to distinguish sabotaged from benign research: they achieve an AUROC of 0.59, not significantly better than chance, and fully identify the specific sabotage in only 17% of cases. Despite not being allowed to run experiments, the best frontier models outperform human auditors (Fable 5.1: AUROC 0.73, 32% full identification) within noise and weaker models perform comparably. When the saboteur chooses which experiments are attacked, rather than being required to sabotage every question given, sabotage identification drops further. Our results suggest that research sabotage by expert-level agents is difficult to detect with current auditing methods and provide a new setting for studying research sabotage.

科研.title: 基于神经网络的迟滞系统建模：从 Prandtl 和 Preisach 神经网络到神经马德隆和神经可塑性连续模型
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.23240v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hysteresis is a complex nonlinear phenomenon characterized by memory dependence, path dependence, and, in many physical systems, degradation, non-congruency, asymmetry, and rate dependence. This review examines the development and capabilities of Prandtl neural networks (PNNs), Preisach neural networks (PreisachNNs), generalized Prandtl neural networks (GPNNs), the neuro-Madelung model (NMM), extended Preisach neural networks (EPNNs), and dynamic plastic continuous neural networks (DPCNNs). Particular attention is given to their mechanisms for representing memory, network architectures, activation functions, training algorithms, treatment of deterioration and rate dependence, and applications to nonlinear structural and material systems. The PNN introduced hysteretic memory directly into neural activation through stop operators and demonstrated accurate nonlinear dynamic analysis of structures. Preisach-NNs subsequently extended this concept through an additional nonlinear hidden layer to represent non-Masing hysteresis. GPNNs introduced deteriorating-stop neurons to capture stiffness and strength degradation and non-congruent hysteresis. A different generalization was provided by the NMM, which combined Madelung's hysteresis rules with multilayer feedforward neural networks to represent diverse rate-independent and rate-dependent behaviors. These developments culminated in the EPNN, which combines deteriorating hysteretic operators, nonlinear neural mappings, and input-rate information to accommodate Masing and nonMasing, symmetric and asymmetric, congruent and noncongruent, and rate-independent and rate-dependent hysteresis.

科研.title: GridForge：适用于英国 11 kV 地下配电电缆的开放式物理信息数字孪生和基准套件
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.23241v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The UK distribution-cable monitoring sector is data-rich but framework-poor: each Distribution Network Operator (DNO) collects megabytes of telemetry per asset per day, but there is no public benchmark dataset, no shared reference model, and no commonly agreed evaluation protocol for benchmarking sectoral, data-intensive models for operational decision support; notably for maintenance planning and prioritisation. We address this gap with GridForge, an open-source physics-informed digital twin and benchmark suite for fault diagnosis and prediction, integrating four building blocks: (i) a verified steady state and transient thermal model based on IEC 60287 and IEC 60853; (ii) a calibrated synthetic dataset of 64 cables (covering 320 cable-years) representing four canonical UK 11 kV thermal archetypes and four condition modes; (iii) a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) surrogate that satisfies the algebraic balance defined by IEC 60287 during training and reaches an RMSE of 0.148 {\deg}C on an independent held out set against the reference analytical oracle; and (iv) a five-task benchmark suite that includes three reference baseline models (pure physics, gradient-boosted trees, and the PINN). All numerical parameters are sourced from public standards, the code is licensed under the MIT licence, and the trained PINN converges in only two minutes (as run on the computing platform in Section 10.1), enabling independent verification by DNO engineering and research practitioners. At present only the virtual-sensor task (T4) discriminates between the reference baselines; the other tasks tie or are undefined on this test split, so extending the baselines with task-specific logic is a priority future enhancement. For open validation, the dataset, test sets and models are made available at https://github.com/mlily2024/Gridforge

科研.title: 尖峰神经网络的仿生尖峰编码和优化
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.23242v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer theoretical energy-efficiency advantages over conventional deep networks, but realizing these advantages on vision tasks requires sparse spike representations that naive rate-coding methods fail to provide. We combine biologically motivated spike-encoding schemes with two training improvements: Rouser adaptive-threshold surrogate gradients and Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature (K-FAC) second-order optimization. The spike encoding schemes experimented with are rate coding, latency coding, DVS-style delta modulation, and Difference-of-Gaussians (DoG) filtering. Experiments on MNIST and Fashion-MNIST demonstrate that biologically inspired encoders yield the largest accuracy gains in capacity-constrained regimes and serve as an effective parameter-efficiency lever. DoG and delta modulation encoders produce significantly sparser spike trains than rate coding. K-FAC yields modest but consistent accuracy improvements over Adam-trained baselines, and Rouser's learnable per-neuron thresholds improve Fashion-MNIST accuracy from 87.37% to 88.13% by enabling homeostatic firing-rate regulation. Biologically grounded pre-processing methods can help close the accuracy gap between SNNs and non-spiking baselines without increasing model size.

科研.title: 戈曼斯的不可分流猜想：人工智能辅助反例发现的剖析
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.23244v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Goemans conjectured that any fractional single-source flow could be converted into an unsplittable flow without increasing total cost and while increasing any arc load by at most the largest demand. Recently, Dmitry Rybin announced a seven-vertex counterexample found through an interaction with ChatGPT, which disproved this long-standing conjecture. However, the interaction did not reveal why this particular topology and its demand, fractional-flow, and cost choices work together, whether the example belongs to a broader family, or which structural features determine where counterexamples can occur. It also left unclear why the AI-assisted search succeeded where earlier human efforts had not. In this paper, we develop a forward counterexample construction pipeline. It starts from an arborescence on which failure is impossible and adds terminal-entering shortcut arcs. The resulting load constraints define a finite set of admissible route choices; their convex hull, the conflict polytope, yields exact conditions for demands, fractional flows, and costs. Starting from a simple arborescence, the pipeline selects Rybin's topology and characterizes all counterexamples it supports. Experiments further demonstrate the pipeline's transferability: when instructed to follow it while varying the initial arborescence and shortcut placement, ChatGPT produced counterexamples on topologies genuinely different from Rybin's and found valid constructions starting from 93 other rooted arborescence shapes. The theory also explains why the original example was difficult to discover through blind enumeration and suggests that Rybin's interaction lies between blind enumeration and a complete theory-guided construction.

科研.title: 交叉探测范德华多铁性
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.23337v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multiferroic materials, with coupled electric and magnetic orders, hold the potential to enable low-power memory and logic devices by replacing electrical currents with electric fields for magnetic switching. Reducing the dimensionality of multiferroics, from 3D to 2D, has opened new frontiers in this already burgeoning field by enabling unprecedented control over magnetoelectric coupling that is beyond the reach of bulk counterparts, owing to reduced electrostatic screening and enhanced quantum fluctuations at the atomically thin limit. A notable example is a few-layer NiI2 multiferroic, which exhibits coexisting chiral spin textures and (anti)ferroelectricity, accompanied by strong magnetoelectric coupling; by simultaneously breaking time-reversal and spatial-inversion symmetry, NiI2 shows new physical properties such as unique mutual control of chiral magnetism and polarization with giant magnetoelectric coupling, ultrafast electromagnon excitations and odd-parity p-wave magnetism. However, there are experimental challenges in unambiguously identifying intrinsic multiferroicity. This Review critically examines the current landscape of 2D multiferroic materials, with an emphasis on experimental methodologies rather than material taxonomy. We assess different conventional probes for magnetism and ferroelectricity and identify key limitations in single-technique approaches. We emphasize the importance of magneto-opto-electric cross-correlative measurements in establishing intrinsic multiferroic behaviour and outline future research directions for both fundamental studies and device applications.

科研.title: 迈向低温 AI 硬件：使用 3 位铁电 Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 电容器在 4 K 下实现超过 99% 的精度内存计算
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.23489v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-accuracy cryogenic hyperdimensional computing (HDC) is demonstrated using Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 (HZO) ferroelectric capacitors (FeCAPs) as multilevel analog memories for capacitive compute in-memory (CIM) architectures. On the ISOLET spoken-word dataset, FeCAP-stored vectors achieve up to 92% classification accuracy at 4 K, while charge-domain matrix-vector multiplication (MVM) exhibits near-ideal behaviour with linearity of 1 and error probability below 1% for 4x4 and 4x8 configurations, operating below 3 V. Unlike the performance at 300 K, HDC and CIM at 4 K remains resilient to electric-field-cycling-induced fatigue, thanks to enhanced cryogenic device characteristics, including reduced state variability, strongly suppressed leakage current and stable retention, as well as 78% faster switching. Furthermore, these multibit FeCAPs exhibit endurance beyond 1E9 cycles with polarization degradation below 8%, preserving multilevel integrity. Benefits can also be observed at 300 K, following cooldown and wake-up pulsing at 4 K and subsequent warming up. These results establish multibit FeCAPs as a highly reliable, ultra-low-energy, and accurate analog CIM platform for future cryogenic AI-computing hardware.

科研.title: 通过高通量成对合成预测固态反应起始温度
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.23527v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Solid-state synthesis still relies on heuristics to choose reaction temperatures. The most widely used, Tammann's rule, places reaction onset at two-thirds of the lowest precursor melting point, but has never been systematically tested. Using an automated laboratory, we heated 1,035 pairwise combinations of 46 common precursors at their Tammann temperatures and identified the products by x-ray diffraction. Only 25% of pairs formed products containing both precursors. Combining these outcomes with text-mined literature syntheses, we trained log-normal accelerated failure time models that treat each fixed-temperature experiment as a bound on the unknown onset temperature. On 26 reactions with onset temperatures measured by in situ x-ray diffraction, a three-descriptor model reduced the mean absolute error from 131{\deg}C (Tammann's rule) to 88{\deg}C; adding 29 further physicochemical descriptors did not improve the model. Reaction onset can therefore be predicted from routine pass/fail synthesis outcomes, and predictions will improve as such data accumulates.

科研.title: 预训练通用机器学习力场在 ZrO2 相变预测中的应用
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.23535v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pretrained universal machine-learning force fields can reduce the cost of finite-temperature molecular dynamics relative to density functional theory. However, most benchmarks test only static properties and do not assess whether these models reproduce the correct phase-transition sequence. Here, we benchmark ten open-source universal machine-learning force fields for zirconia (ZrO$_2$) using phonon dispersion calculations and variable-cell isothermal-isobaric molecular dynamics. Zirconia is a useful test because it has three thermodynamically stable crystalline phases prior to melting, following the sequence monoclinic-tetragonal-cubic. Four models reproduce this sequence: 7net-l3i5, MatterSim-v1.0.0-1M, MACE-mpa, and MACE-D3. Models with orthorhombic-tetragonal energy errors above about 10 meV/atom (7net-0, CHGNet, and MACE) instead produce an orthorhombic intermediate and predict monoclinic-orthorhombic-tetragonal-cubic-liquid upon heating. ORB-based models fail to sustain stable variable-cell dynamics because their phonon frequencies are compressed by 30-60% relative to the density functional theory reference. Across all ten models, two ground-state diagnostics predict finite-temperature behavior. Relative polymorph energetics should agree with the matched density functional theory reference within about 6 meV/atom, and the phonon spectrum should not show systematic softening. These diagnostics are practical screening metrics for assessing pretrained force fields for phase-transition predictions.

科研.title: 热载流子和热吸收体太阳能电池中的非理想吸收体：损耗和热回收
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.24194v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The hot carrier solar cell exhibits a photovoltaic conversion efficiency limit of 85.4%. Among the idealizations necessary to achieve this efficiency, it has traditionally been considered essential that the electrons absorbing sunlight do not end up transferring the captured energy to the crystal lattice. In this work, we argue that such a requirement is not necessary if the absorber is thermally insulated. In our analysis, we also consider the possibility of ohmic losses in the absorber due to finite electrical conductivity. We also demonstrate that such losses, delivered as heat, can be partially recycled into electrical work with an efficiency that is given by the Carnot factor. The high efficiencies reported here are thermodynamic limits obtained with ideal energy-selective contacts and negligible parasitic contact conductance, not projections of practical device efficiency. Our work includes a sensitivity analysis for finite contact-mediated heat leakage, and the results are presented as design targets.

科研.title: 适用于高频应用的渐变基极 III 族氮化物 HBT 的设计和建模
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.24790v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work analyzes the high-frequency performance constraints of AlGaN/GaN heterojunction bipolar transistors (HBTs) and proposes a novel band-engineered graded base N-polar AlGaN/GaN HBT and evaluates the RF performances. Unlike conventional p-GaN base designs, we propose a graded base in the N-polar orientation which offers polarization-induced hole accumulation with quasi-electric field-assisted minority carrier transport. The proposed design simultaneously mitigates the longstanding current crowding, Webster effect, and conventional base resistance limitations. Using well-calibrated two-dimensional TCAD simulations, the proposed compositionally graded base HBT projects peak f_T/f_{max} of 190/200 GHz with a power density (V_{br}I_{max}/8 > 20 W/mm), offering a promising pathway toward simultaneous high-frequency and high-power GaN millimeter-wave electronics.

科研.title: 光神经网络应该通过功能来评估，而不仅仅是物理
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.23610v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Optical neural networks (ONNs) are attracting significant attention as alternative platforms for machine learning (ML). In an ONN, an optical module often takes over part of the computation inside a digital ML pipeline. How much of the task does the optical module itself perform, and how much does it contribute to any claimed system-level advantages, such as throughput or energy? This paper offers a simple, function-oriented evaluation methodology. Whatever its internal physics, the optical module appears to the surrounding digital pipeline as a mapping between real-valued tensors. We therefore evaluate it in three steps: (i) define its boundary in the pipeline, as real-valued tensors in and out; (ii) replace it with standard digital modules to identify those that match the optical system's performance on the same task and metric; and (iii) state system-level claims, such as speed or energy, per inference against the performance-matched digital module. We summarize steps (i) and (ii) in an Expressivity Card and demonstrate its use on published ONN systems. This helps isolate the optical module's contribution and provides a concrete digital reference for assessing its claimed system-level advantages, without the need to understand the physics. While we focus on optical systems as the most prominent example, the same approach applies to any physical analog computing platform used in ML, wherever a physical module takes over part of a digital pipeline.

科技.title: 《GTA 6》Xbox Series S 版是首款采用 AMD FSR 4.1 超分技术的游戏
科技.summary: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，《侠盗猎车手 6》（GTA 6）Xbox Series S 版似乎是首款使用 AMD FSR 4.1 超分辨率技术的主机游戏。 上个月，微软宣布，Xbox Series X/S 游戏主机以及 Xbox ROG Ally X 掌机将在后续更新中获得 AMD 最新的超分辨率技术支持。 FSR 4.1 是 AMD 对标英伟达（Nvidia）DLSS 的技术，利用机器学习提升游戏画面分辨率、生成额外帧数，并改善光线追踪效果。 与 DLSS 类似，FSR 4.1 的主要优势在于，开发者可以先以较低分辨率渲染游戏，再通过 FSR 将画面提升至 4K，同时尽可能接近原生 4K 渲染效果。这样既能提升游戏性能，也有助于在不明显牺牲画质的情况下实现更高帧率。 如今，Rockstar 已确认，《GTA 6》Xbox Series S 版采用了 FSR 技术，以便在保留光线追踪、发丝渲染等处理器密集型特效的同时，达到目标分辨率和帧率。 Rockstar 技术高级副总裁乔纳森 · 阿什克罗夫特（Jonathon Ashcroft）、技术总监克里斯 · 奥特（Chris Oat）以及技术制作总监马克 · 钱伯斯（Marc Chambers）在向 Wccftech 提供的一份联合声明中，介绍了游戏在不同主机平台上的技术方案。 声明称：“开发初期我们就意识到，考虑到团队的宏大目标，本世代主机的目标帧率将设定为 30fps。我们投入了大量精力，在画面表现、游戏模拟和玩法之间取得平衡，同时确保游戏输入延迟相比《GTA 5》和《荒野大镖客：救赎 2》有显著改善。” “这一过程中，我们还需要确定基础渲染分辨率和超分辨率方案。我们针对每款主机评估了多种技术路线，最终选择了能够满足画面效果和性能要求的组合方案。” “在 PlayStation 5 和 Xbox Series X 上，我们采用自研的 TAA（时间抗锯齿）方案，将 1440p 基础分辨率提升至 4K。Xbox Series S 则以 720p 为基础分辨率，通过 AMD FSR Upscaling 4 将画面提升至 1080p。至于 PlayStation 5 Pro，我们利用 PSSR2 技术，将 1440p 基础分辨率提升至 4K。” Rockstar 确认 Xbox Series S 版使用 AMD FSR 技术，这也意味着《GTA 6》可能是首款支持近期新增超分技术的 Xbox Series S 游戏。 IT之家注意到，这也能解释 Digital Foundry 近期对 Xbox Series S 版《GTA 6》的分析结果。此前，该媒体对游戏中出现光线追踪等处理器密集型技术感到意外，同时认为其整体画面表现“确实与 Series X 版相当接近”。 Digital Foundry 在视频中表示：“Series S 版仍然有着非常鲜明的《GTA 6》风格。与我们在其他 3A 游戏的 Series S 版本中经常看到的画质妥协相比，这里的取舍其实并不算大。” 该媒体还称，Rockstar 在 Xbox Series S 版上的工作值得肯定，因为“他们将一款规模庞大、表现令人印象深刻、能够在 PS5 和 Series X 上以 30fps 运行的游戏，移植到了性能弱得多的硬件上。即便是那些游戏规模远小于《GTA 6》的开发项目，也曾难以驾驭这款主机”。 不过，Xbox Series S 版仍然难以稳定维持 30fps。Digital Foundry 最后总结称：“Rockstar 打造了一个相当忠于原版设计理念的 Series S 版本，核心技术也都以合理的形式得到了保留。但目前 Series S 版的帧率表现并不理想，我建议玩家暂时选择其他主机平台体验这款游戏。”

科技.title: 比亚迪发布 DMS 超级混动：DM-i 的能耗、DM-p 的性能、DMO 的越野
科技.summary: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，在今天（19 日）晚间的方程豹钛 9 上市发布会上，比亚迪正式发布 DMS 超级混动全能平台。其整合 DM-i（节能）、DM-p（性能）、DMO（越野）三大技术路线，号称“为全能而生”。 IT之家从发布会内容获悉，DMS 平台首创后驱矢量控制技术，融合 差速器、差速锁、电子限滑、轮端解耦 ，实现“大而强、大而灵、大而稳、大而省”。 技术层面，后电机全速域解耦支持在 高速巡航时直接断开后电机 ，从而减少拖拽阻力，实现节省能耗的效果。后桥的左右输出功率支持 0-100% 调节，实现真正的“后轮独立控制”，保障不同工况下车辆的稳定性和通过性。 这项技术将在方程豹钛 9 上首发，以该车为例，其搭载的 1.5T+400kW 双电机动力系统，系统总功率号称媲美 3.0T 发动机，百公里加速 仅需 4.8 秒 ，百公里亏电油耗 6.4 升。 同时，该车还支持后轮转向、蟹行模式、豹式掉头。

科技.title: 网传格力电器因 150 元成被执行人？朱磊回应称系诉讼费缴款，属正常司法公示
科技.summary: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，一则关于“格力电器被列为被执行人”的消息在网络上传开。中国执行信息公开网信息显示，格力电器新增一则小额被执行人信息，立案时间为 11 月 17 日， 执行标的为 150 元 ，执行法院为义乌市人民法院，案件号为（2026）浙 0782 执 32271 号。 珠海格力电器股份有限公司市场总监朱磊就此事作出回应，IT之家附原文如下： 关于近期网传“格力电器被列为被执行人”一事，我给大家说明一下情况： 此事源于格力起诉义乌商家在网上违规售卖格力售后工作服的商标侵权案件 。格力售后工作服为内部统一配发，严控外流，目的是防范不法人员冒充格力售后上门，保护消费者人身与财产安全。 该案经法院调解，对方需停止侵权、赔偿损失，诉讼费由我方承担。 11 月 19 日收到缴费通知后，我们已及时完成缴费 。司法公示是公开流程，请大家理性看待。一些媒体拿一个正常的司法公示做文章令人不解。格力将持续打击商标侵权，守护消费者权益。

科技.title: R 星回应《GTA 6》为何没有飞镖、保龄球小游戏：宁缺毋滥，做不到高标准就不做
科技.summary: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，Rockstar Games 解释了为什么《侠盗猎车手 6》（GTA 6）没有加入部分玩家期待的小游戏，例如飞镖和保龄球。Rockstar 联合工作室负责人罗布 · 尼尔森（Rob Nelson）表示，开发团队改变了小游戏的设计思路，不愿意加入任何达不到自身质量标准的内容。 IT之家注意到，飞镖曾出现在此前两款《GTA》系列作品以及《GTA Online》中，而保龄球则曾在《GTA 4》及其资料片中登场。 不过，Rockstar North 联合工作室负责人、同时也是《GTA 6》制作人的尼尔森在接受 VGC 采访时表示，开发团队如今对小游戏有了不同的理解，因此并没有将这些经典项目全部带入新作。 尼尔森坦言：“飞镖这个项目确实有些争议。即使外界认为我们有无限的资金和时间，但事实并非如此。有时候，我们只能承认，自己无法把某个项目做到理想中的水准。” 他解释称，这种设计理念可以追溯到工作室上一款作品《荒野大镖客：救赎 2》（Red Dead Redemption 2）。 “我认为这种变化始于《荒野大镖客：救赎 2》。从那时起，我们就开始把小游戏当作真正的活动来设计。” 尼尔森表示，《GTA 6》中的小游戏必须成为游戏机制的自然延伸，而不是简单地添加几个供玩家消磨时间的互动选项。他还透露，尽管《荒野大镖客：救赎 2》中有一副戏份颇多的达奇棋盘，但开发团队当时在加入国际象棋玩法时也遇到了不少困难。 谈到《GTA 6》中的台球玩法时，他表示：“这就是我们对台球的处理方式。它拥有真正的物理模拟，本身就是一款完整的游戏。” 尼尔森补充说，开发团队更倾向于加入那些能够真实还原现实体验的互动内容。举重就是一个典型例子。 “玩家并不是简单地按下一个按钮，游戏会模拟真实的举重动作。” 他表示，要让这些互动内容达到理想效果，需要投入大量时间进行调试。至于飞镖，团队最终没能完成这项内容。 尼尔森告诉 VGC，如果 Rockstar 决定加入飞镖玩法，就必须确保它的表现足够真实、完整。《GTA 6》中的篮球互动则是一个很好的例子。虽然玩家无法进行完整的篮球比赛，但可以自由跑动、流畅投篮，整个操作过程也保持了良好的一致性。 这位联合工作室负责人坦言，开发团队当时没有足够的资源完成所有想做的内容，而资源限制也是工作室开发其他游戏时经常面临的问题。 他最后总结道：“与其把某个功能做出来，却达不到足够好的水准，不如干脆不做。” 经过 13 年的漫长等待，《GTA 6》终于于本周正式发售。VGC 在评测中将其称为“本世代最佳游戏”。 评测写道：“《侠盗猎车手 6》是一部现代杰作。Rockstar 的开发人员打造了一个非凡的开放世界，在叙事、玩法、画面、音乐和技术等方面都表现出色，创造了真正难以匹敌的体验。虽然存在一些轻微的性能问题，但丝毫没有掩盖这款游戏的光彩。它绝对值得一玩，漫长的等待也完全没有白费。”

科技.summary: 黄仁勋的下台可能削弱开放权重模型生态，让 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等闭源模型开发商受益。黄仁勋此前曾利用英伟达的资金打造一个广泛的 AI 生态系统。他通过投资和收购初创企业，支持开发开源和开放权重模型。黄仁勋是此类模型推广的坚定倡导者，曾游说反对华盛顿限制使用中国的开放权重模型，积极推动美国本土开放权重模型的开发。一位风险投资人表示，失去黄仁勋以及英伟达在投资上不再那么慷慨，我们可能最终会面对一个模型提供商高度集中的世界。一位业内人士表示不认为开放权重模型会就此消失，但失去黄仁勋这位最强大的财务支持者和拥护者，无疑会拖慢它们的发展进程。

科技.title: 微软官方 agent-framework 软件包被黑客劫持安装恶意程序
科技.summary: 微软托管在 PyPI 上的 agent-framework 软件包被黑客劫持安装窃取信息的恶意程序。agent-framework 每月下载量近 20 万次，主要用于构建和部署 AI 智能体。受影响的版本是 v1.26.1 和 1.26.2，会窃取开发者在 Azure、Git、Docker、Hugging Face 等服务上的环境变量、凭据文件以及其它敏感信息。更糟糕的是软件包无需被导入，只要安装该软件包的 Python 解释器启动，恶意代码便会运行。微软发言人在一份声明中表示在调查期间它将部分软件包项目设为私有。

科技.title: 蚊子在喜马拉雅冰川地区日益常见
科技.summary: 随着全球暖化冰川消退，蚊子在喜马拉雅冰川地区日益常见，将一些流行病带给了当地居民。克什米尔 Ladakh 一个名叫 Sakti 的村庄海拔 3900 米，居住着约四百户村民，大多属于 Boto 族。65 岁的村民 Phunchok Gyalpo 一生都居住在 Sakti，他说小时候每逢下雪，通常要等好几天才能清理出路。但过去二三十年这种情况再也没发生过。他提到现在的冬天也暖和多了。Ladakh 是一个高海拔寒冷沙漠地区，位于喜马拉雅山的雨影区，当地居民的饮用水和农业灌溉都依赖冰川。他们唯一的水源是融化的冰雪。很少有地方能像 Ladakh 展现全球暖化的影响，蚊子的出现就是证据。2022 年 Ladakh 报告了首批两例登革热病例。2024 年出现了两例疟疾病例，2025 年又新增三例。2026 年至今它尚未报告登革热病例，而克什米尔则报告了 17 例。Ladakh 历史上首次出现了在屋内安装吊扇的情况。市场上充斥着驱蚊产品，人们也能亲眼见到蚊子。夏季变暖、冬季更温和以及无霜期的出现，使得蚊子的活动范围向高海拔地区扩张。
